column1: # Groups for authors with many works, shown as headings on the library page.
# One rule per line, separated by TABS: author id, group name, pattern.
# The pattern is a regular expression matched against the work's title (case ignored);
# start it with desc: to match the edition description instead. First matching rule wins;
# works that match no rule are listed under "Other works". Edit freely, then run: python perseus.py build
